entities.name: PDU Session Establishment Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for establishing a PDU session between UE and network. This clause specifies rejection scenarios.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by SMF to reject PDU session establishment request.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request PDU session establishment.

entities.name: 5GSM cause
entities.description: IE indicating reason for PDU session establishment rejection.

entities.name: Back-off timer value
entities.description: Optional IE included in REJECT message to control UE re-attempt timing.

entities.name: Re-attempt indicator
entities.description: IE indicating whether UE is allowed to re-attempt PDU session establishment.

entities.name: Service-level-AA container
entities.description: IE containing service-level authentication and authorization information.

entities.name: PDU session type
entities.description: IE indicating requested PDU session type (IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6, Unstructured, Ethernet).

entities.name: SSC mode
entities.description: IE indicating requested Session and Service Continuity mode.

entities.name: T3580
entities.description: Timer running during PDU session establishment procedure.

entities.name: DN connectivity rejected
entities.description: Condition where connectivity with requested Data Network is rejected by network.

entities.name: SMF creates REJECT message
entities.description: SMF behavior to create PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message when connectivity is rejected.

relations.description: PDU session establishment procedure includes sending REJECT message when rejected.
REJECT message contains 5GSM cause IE indicating rejection reason.
REJECT message may contain Back-off timer value IE.
REJECT message may contain Re-attempt indicator IE.
REQUEST message contains PDU session type IE.
REQUEST message may contain SSC mode IE.
REQUEST message may contain Service-level-AA container IE.
When DN connectivity is rejected, SMF creates REJECT message.
Upon receipt of REJECT message, UE stops timer T3580.
